name: OpenMAIC
description: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click
one_liner: A one-click app that spins up a classroom of AI 'characters' who teach and interact with a student together, instead of one chatbot answering questions.
buyer: An online tutoring or edtech startup founder building interactive lesson experiences for kids or exam prep.
business_use_cases: An edtech startup builds subject-specific interactive classrooms (a mock historical debate, a science lab walkthrough) for a paid tutoring app.
A corporate training team creates multi-persona onboarding simulations where new hires talk to several AI 'coworkers' at once.
A language school offers immersive roleplay conversation practice with multiple AI characters instead of one static bot.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a branded, subject-specific version of the classroom experience to schools or tutoring centers.
License the multi-agent classroom engine to existing edtech platforms as an add-on feature.

steal_this: Fork it, pick one subject (say, GCSE history), and build a single polished interactive classroom demo to pitch to a language-learning academy this weekend.
